key_insight: HISPO improves long-form mathematical reasoning by splitting responses into entropy-derived segments and applying importance-sampling correction at the segment level, giving a middle ground between token-level and sequence-level credit assignment.
engineering_relevance: For RLVR systems, the method offers a practical way to stabilize learning on lengthy solutions where important reasoning steps are unevenly distributed across a completion.
method: Build rollout-time contiguous segments using entropy signals from the generated trace.
Assign soft saliency weights to segments based on entropy-derived importance.
Apply clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment granularity.
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO improved Pass@8 on all benchmarks and matched or exceeded the best baseline in Acc@8 on five, including gains on AIME25 over both GRPO and GSPO.
watch_item: Segment construction depends on entropy estimates and rollout-time heuristics, so performance may be sensitive to segmentation quality and hyperparameter choices.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
